request.query: l1 norm triangle inequality for finitely supported functions

items.name: norm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖

items.name: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ε' : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε']
  [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε'] {p : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [ContinuousAdd ε'] {ι : Type u_5}
  {f : ι → α → ε'} {s : Finset ι},
  (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ) →
    1 ≤ p → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (∑ i ∈ s, f i) p μ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (f i) p μ

items.name: Real.Lp_add_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {p : ℝ},
  1 ≤ p → (∑ i ∈ s, |f i + g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) + (∑ i ∈ s, |g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p)

items.name: nnnorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊

items.name: nnnorm_sum_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → NNReal},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b

items.name: enorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_9} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → ε), ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ₑ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₑ
